newsitem.title: USA: Status of Mrs Clinton's Africa trip unclear.
newsitem.headline: Status of Mrs Clinton's Africa trip unclear.

text.p: President Bill Clinton's leg injury cast doubt on Friday on whether Hillary Rodham Clinton would be able to depart as scheduled on Saturday for a two-week tour of Africa.
Mrs. Clinton's spokeswoman, Marsha Berry, said it was unclear yet how Clinton's injury would affect the first lady's plans. "We just don't know yet," she said.
Mrs. Clinton was waiting to see the severity of the president's injury, suffered early on Friday in Florida at the estate of golf pro Greg Norman.
She was scheduled to depart on Saturday morning for Dakar, Senegal, the first leg of a six-nation tour of the African continent.
Her goodwill mission also was to take her to South Africa, Zimbabwe, Tanzania, Uganda and Eritrea. It would be the first lady's ninth solo trip outside the United States.
